role: county government, project proponent and airport operator
stance_basis: Milwaukee County coordinated with FAA and Division of Highways to develop the recommended Corridor #5, and the Milwaukee County Board favored construction of the Airport Spur at the public hearing
summary: Milwaukee County is a key project proponent and airport operator who actively participated in developing the recommended Corridor #5 to be compatible with General Mitchell Field's Air Terminal Master Plan. The County acquired land for the 60-acre air cargo area, which shaped the corridor selection, and the Milwaukee County Board testified in favor of the Airport Spur at the March 25, 1969 Location Public Hearing. Milwaukee County's Park Commission also confirmed the proposed facility did not interfere with any existing or proposed park development.
complaint_summary: At the March 25, 1969 Location Public Hearing, the Milwaukee County Board testified in favor of construction of the Airport Spur, and Milwaukee County's Park Commission indicated the proposed facility did not interfere with any existing or proposed park development.
summary_quote: It was the result of coordinated efforts by Airport Officials, Milwaukee County, Federal Aviation Administration, and the Division of Highways to be compatible with the adopted long range Master Plan for the expansion of facilities at General Mitchell Field.
